The 8x64 full-height tile measured 3.061 μs, the 8x16 subtile 3.839 μs, and the 16x64 full-height tile 3.249 μs; these timings do not identify a cause. This candidate holds the 16-row y subtile and its radius-4 halos fixed while widening x from 8 to 16, halving the x-block count and doubling threads per block. It tests whether better x access and fewer blocks offset the larger blocks and unchanged relative halo overhead.
